Lymphoma: The patient presents with systemic symptoms such as intermittent fevers, night sweats, and decreased appetite, along with painful left lower-extremity swelling and erythema. The presence of bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses, lymphadenopathy, and a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the skin biopsy are highly suggestive of lymphoma.
